questions.cardText:
[Architecture] Which of the following structures is a masterpiece of the architect Antoni Gaudí in Barcelona?
A. Sagrada Família
B. Hospital de Sant Pau
C. El Fadrí
Answer: A. This iconic church has been under construction for over a century since 1882.
questions.de: Welche Basilika in Barcelona, seit 1882 im Bau, gilt als Meisterwerk Antoni Gaudís?
questions.en: Which Barcelona basilica, under construction since 1882, is Antoni Gaudí's masterpiece?

timeline.labelEn: Construction of the Sagrada Família begins in Barcelona; Gaudí takes over in 1883
timeline.labelDe: Baubeginn der Sagrada Família in Barcelona; Gaudí übernimmt 1883

questions.notes: Construction began 19 March 1882 under Francisco de Paula del Villar; Gaudí took over in 1883.

questions.cardText:
[Law] How do Japanese pachinko parlors (“casinos”) circumvent gambling laws?
A. By providing cash to a third person nominated by the winner
B. By using exchange shops
C. By operating only at certain hours
Answer: B. Though Japan has strict anti-gambling laws, it allows parlors to provide prizes. Players would exchange them for cash at separate, nearby shops that often recycle the prizes back to the parlors.
questions.de: Japanische Pachinko-Hallen dürfen kein Bargeld auszahlen. Wo tauschen Spieler ihre Sonderpreise in Geld um?
questions.en: Japanese pachinko parlors may not pay out cash. Where do players turn their special prizes into money?
questions.answerDe: In separaten Tauschläden in der Nähe

timeline.labelEn: Pachinko emerges as an adult pastime in Nagoya
timeline.labelDe: Pachinko kommt in Nagoya als Freizeitvergnügen für Erwachsene auf

questions.notes: Balls are traded in the parlor for 'special prize' tokens (tokushu keihin), sold for cash to an off-premises vendor that sells them back to the parlor.
